title: Operator credential handshake, evidence runbook, and gating for private deployments
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: This ticket delivers a prescriptive runbook and signoff gating for operator credential handshakes and evidence capture for Private deployments (VPC and on-prem). It covers SSO/SAML assertion lifecycle verification, RBAC audit trails for operator actions, KMS/HSM key custody handshake during upgrade and operator rotation, and an evidence playback plan for audits. The goal is to provide a rigorous, testable acceptance surface for onboarding enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements. The runbook should be usable by solutions engineers, site reliability, and customer security reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Operator credential handshake documented end-to-end with sequence diagrams and concrete tooling commands for both SAML and OIDC flows.
AC2: A reproducible evidence capture procedure that produces an immutable artifact bundle (logs, signed timestamps, key rotation events) for a simulated operator rotation scenario.

AC3: RBAC audit trail tests that show operator actions (grant, revoke, escalate) are recorded with sufficient context (actor, target resource, before/after) and are forward-searchable in the console within 30s.
AC4: KMS/HSM quorum degradation and recovery playbook with test vectors showing failed signing attempts and successful failover to escrowed keys where allowed by policy.
AC5: Security reviewer signoff matrix completed with named approvers for SSO, KMS, and RBAC and explicit pass/fail criteria for each checklist item.
AC6: Automated CI test that replays a pre-specified assertion replay attack and verifies detection and alerting rules trigger as documented.
AC7: Customer-facing checklist and a short compliance summary PDF produced and attached for onboarding teams.
checklist: Draft sequence diagrams for SAML/OIDC handshake and operator-kms interaction
Define evidence artifact schema and required retention period
Implement CI tests for RBAC event capture and log integrity
Create HSM failure/recovery scenarios and scripts for replay
Coordinate with Solutions Eng to validate runbook against two customers (one VPC, one on-prem)
Produce signoff matrix and collect initial approver ACKs

decisions: Decision 1: Evidence bundle will be a compressed tar with a signed manifest using customer KMS where available; fallback uses operator escrow key.
Decision 2: RBAC events must surface in console with a 30s SLA for searchability; long term we will index events into Splunk/ES for retention beyond 365 days.
Decision 3: For air-gapped on-prem, runbook will include an offline evidence-signing procedure requiring operator presence and HSM-attested timestamps.
risks: R1: HSM vendor differences may make a single test script brittle across customers
R2: Customer-managed KMS means we cannot sign a uniform manifest in all cases; fallback increases operator burden
R3: Tight RBAC SLA on console search may require infra changes (ENG dependency)
R4: Evidence playback for legal requests may require additional redaction tooling not in scope
